title: Equal, or the same node?
hints: `square(lit(3))` puts one node in the list twice. `Node("mul", [lit(3), lit(3)])` calls `lit` twice, so it holds two nodes. Which question tells those apart?
`==` on a dataclass compares the fields, so two separate nodes with the same fields are equal. You want the question "is this the very same object?"
explain: The reference returns `n.src[0] is n.src[1]`. `is` is true only when both places in the list hold the very same object, which is what `square` builds. With `==`, two separate nodes that were built the same way also count, because a dataclass compares fields.
